ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.5.3 (TieJin Modify) 无主和有主性奴共用四阶进度。可通过奴性爆发或绑定仪式按原进度建立绑定，主动解绑或主人死亡后保留进度转为无主；两日解绑后效随人格凝胶暂停并在植入后续计。 本版包含恶堕与锁链阶段解耦、奴性爆发、淫堕传道及凝胶统一结算，并修复倒地调教与救援循环。 新内容面向 RimWorld 1.7。1.6 使用 SSC 2.4.1。Harmony 和 RJW 先于 SSC，文化与仪式需要 Ideology。
Unbound and bound slaves share four stages. Submission Breakdown and Binding Rituals can establish a bond at the pawn's existing progress. Manual release or Master death preserves that progress as an unbound state. The two-day release effect pauses in Personality Gel and resumes after implantation. Includes Corruption and Chain decoupling, Submission Breakdown, Preaching Corruption and shared Depravity Gel bookkeeping, plus fixes for downed Training and rescue loops. New content targets RimWorld 1.7. The 1.6 component uses SSC 2.4.1. Load Harmony and RJW before SSC. Culture and rituals require Ideology.
